device.notes: DGX Spark GB10 (Grace ARM + Blackwell). 128 GB unified LPDDR5x, 273 GB/s. Identity UUID/PCI intentionally omitted from the repo — the fingerprint hash already keys the file; raw device serials never get committed.

_autotune_note: Empty by design: the CUDA backend has no online GEMM-vs-matvec autotune (dense projections route through cuBLAS, MoE through the specialised NVFP4 / FP4-TC kernels). The `autotune` array is populated only for the L0/Xe-LPG backend, where mimirmind-probe sweeps per-QuantType GEMM-vs-vec. A fingerprint match here is a HIT (visibility + Layer-2 hook) but applies no matmul-variant override.

flags._note: Deployed known-good perf configuration for this GPU (the mimirmind analogue of vLLM's committed per-GPU config JSONs). `apply:true` = the runtime auto-enables this flag at model load from this profile (Layer-2), so it survives a restart without any env; `apply:false` = advisory only (recorded, not driven) until validated. An explicit env var always overrides (debug wins). `default_on` = already the code default; `env_gated` = only active via env until its apply flips true.

MIMIRMIND_ATTN_CUDNN.effect: cuDNN-9 SDPA fused flash prefill attention; hand kernel is the parity-gated fallback. Validated (-19.7% prefill), safe to auto-apply.

MIMIRMIND_F32_TC_PREFILL.effect: F32 small weights (router / GDN beta-alpha / shexp-router) -> BF16-TC instead of per-row F32 vec. Encoder/reranker protected via ScopedExactF32, but TF32's 10-bit mantissa on the LLM MoE router is unvalidated (could shift expert argmax) — apply:false until the DE-goldset gate (Increment C).

MIMIRMIND_CUBLAS_FP8_PREFILL.effect: Dense prefill projections -> FP8 (E4M3) tensor cores. Lossy, parity-gated, BF16/wmma fallback. apply:false until a DE RAG-goldset A/B clears it (Increment C).

matmul._note: Kernel-variant picks for this GPU. mimirmind's own decisions — NOT Triton BLOCK_M/N/K tiles, because we run hand-CUDA + cuBLAS/CUTLASS, not a Triton JIT. The shape-keyed tile-param table that vLLM's fused_moe/configs carries is a future field (moe.shape_configs) once we mine CUTLASS / benchmark_moe-style sweeps.

provenance.derived: Hand-curated 2026-08-21 from the live Spark prod deploy, not an automated sweep — hence probe_status=curated-partial.
provenance.calibration: The `flags` block is the vLLM-committed-config analogue and is the actionable content today; the runtime loader currently only consumes fingerprint/model_id/probe_status/autotune, so this file registers as a HIT for visibility. Wiring the loader to APPLY `flags` (Layer-2 value-apply) is roadmap 5.19 Increment A.2. Honest scope: measured prefill win of the flag set is -47.5% on a 3438-tok prompt (10.85s -> 5.70s), ~-24% end-to-end RAG.
